title: Add the Phase 1.6 master spec to the plans documentation set
summary: Add src/content/docs/plans/phase-1-6-master-spec.mdoc, the Phase 1.6 Knowledge/Research/Understanding/Decision master architecture V5.0 (memory model, provenance system, provider continuity, PR-0 through PR-8 sequence).

Conform the supplied document to this repo's real Markdoc conventions: add required frontmatter, remove a duplicate manual H1/H2 the layout already renders from frontmatter, and extract its twelve inline Mermaid code fences into canonical .mmd sources rendered through the existing mermaid_diagram tag.

Extend the architecture/diagrams.mdoc catalog with those twelve new Mermaid views so the diagram-coverage rule (every .mmd source rendered on the catalog page) still holds, and add public/diagrams to the shared publication manifest's allowed path prefixes so documentation/diagram PRs can pass the real scope gate.
risk: Low: documentation and diagram-source-only change; no orchestration, schema, runtime, or business-surface code is touched.

This lands planning content only — per the spec's own authority invariant (Section 19) and hard-stop conditions (Section 35.2), it authorizes no execution by itself; PR-0 implementation work follows separately once this is merged.

npm run docs:build, npm run typecheck, npm run ci:links, npm run ci:quality, npm run ci:security, and npm run test:browser:prebuilt (updated diagram-count assertions from 6 to 18) all pass locally against this candidate.
npm run phase15:audit independently re-verified complete-frozen (localReady/publicationReady/externalReady all true) at the branch point before this work began.
